components.text: Master the Magic: Pro Prompting Tips

components.content:
Unlock unparalleled results with these insider keywords.

Getting the perfect princess carry is all about precise language. Use these specialized terms to guide the AI to your desired outcome:

items.title: The Pose
items.content: "elegant bridal carry," "heroic strong carry," "cradling carefully," "lifted effortlessly," "swept off her feet."

items.title: Key Details
items.content: "flowing dress over arm," "hand supporting back," "muscles tensed slightly," "intertwined fingers."

items.prompt: Cinematic wide shot, golden hour lighting, a tall athletic Caucasian man performing a strong yet tender princess carry for a blonde woman on a pristine beach. Her light blue chiffon dress is caught in the ocean breeze, flowing beautifully. They are walking along the shoreline with gentle waves lapping at their feet. Intense eye contact, backlighting creating a glowing halo effect around their hair. 8k resolution, romantic aesthetic, masterpiece, sunset colors of orange and pink.

Photorealistic, high-end lifestyle photography. A handsome European man in a white linen shirt carrying his partner in his arms (princess carry) on a sunny Mediterranean beach. Both are barefoot, laughter and genuine smiles, messy wind-swept hair. Clear turquoise water in the background, soft white sand. Natural skin textures, sunlight reflecting off the water. Shot on Sony A7R IV, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, bright and airy.

Epic fantasy romance, oil painting style but realistic details. An athletic Caucasian knight or prince carrying a blonde princess in an ornate, heavy velvet dress. Setting is a grand baroque ballroom with golden chandeliers. Dramatic lighting, dust motes dancing in the sunbeams. The way he holds her shows both strength and extreme gentleness. Deep emotional connection, rich color palette (gold, crimson, emerald), highly detailed embroidery.

Candid photography, soft natural morning light. A fit Caucasian couple in a sun-drenched modern loft. The man is tenderly carrying her (princess carry) towards a large floor-to-ceiling window. He is wearing a white linen shirt, she is in a soft knitted sweater. Intimate gaze, messy hair, genuine smiles. High-end lifestyle photography, soft shadows, airy and bright aesthetic, shot on 35mm lens.

Extreme detail, medium shot. A Caucasian couple at the beach during twilight. The man is holding her in a protective princess carry. She has her arms wrapped tightly around his neck, forehead leaning against his. Emotional intimacy, focus on their expressions of love. The woman's silk dress is slightly damp from the sea spray. Cool blue tones of the ocean contrasting with the warm skin tones. Moody atmosphere, soft bokeh, ultra-detailed textures.
